Click to expand...
To try and remove results that you don't want try
rpg maker vx ace blah blah -mv -mz
the - is used to say 'do not include results with this'
Try the recovering scripts thread. in there are a lot of scripts and links to other githubs, including yanfly.
Recovering Lost Scripts
Sometimes I get really nostalgic and I want to use VXA. But due to Dropbox cancelling their public links, websites shutting down, etc. A lot of scripts are gone through the void of darkness. So I started a Github of stuff that I have to hopefully recover lost scripts...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
